annotations.title: Archive, restore or delete a lead conversation

description: Archive a conversation out of the business inbox, restore it, or delete it permanently — the dashboard's conversation controls. Requires the user's confirmation (deleting is irreversible).

confirmation_token.description: Leave empty on the first call: you get an action_summary and a token instead of the action. After the user explicitly confirms that summary, call again with the SAME arguments plus this token.
